Alex M: Hey people-ops — onboarding for a new senior platform engineer starts Mon. Can someone share a tight first-week agenda + a short 30/60/90 manager template? Need to hand off by EOD Fri. Thanks! :wave:
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! Quick outline below. I also put together a calendar template and a one-page who-to-ask sheet.
Priya (People Ops): First-week agenda (compact):
- Day 0: preboarding — accounts provisioned, device shipped, VPN & SSO checks
- Day 1: intro / org overview, 1:1 with manager (30m), team meet & greet (45m)
- Day 2: infra tour + Redwood Console walkthrough (1.5h) + Dedicated pools handoff (45m)
- Day 3: shadow oncall + runbook review (1.5h)
- Day 4: small "hello" task (repo checkout + dev workflow) + walk through CI (2-3h)
- Day 5: sync with mentor + 30-day goals planning (30-45m)
Priya (People Ops): Short who-to-ask (single-sentence contacts):
- Dedicated pools & reservations: Jamal (eng-platform)
- Console dashboards & tracing: Marta (eng-observability)
- SSO/KMS/HSM & security approvals: @sec-admin
- Laptop / badge / VPN: IT -> @it-ops
- Slack channels + intros: Alex M
Jamal: I can own Dedicated access — will schedule Tue 10:00 for a 45m walk-through.
Marta: I'll take Console + tracing quickstart Wed 11:00 and will attach a 15-min runbook.
Alex M: Perfect. Can we also get a 30/60/90 that is one page and manager-friendly (copyable into offer/onboarding doc)?
Priya (People Ops): Yep — minimal 30/60/90 to copy: 
```
30-day: ramp — complete access, ship a small task, meet stakeholders, complete assigned learning modules
60-day: own a cross-team improvement, take shadowed oncall shifts, baseline infra perf metrics
90-day: lead a production change, propose measurable roadmap items, onboard a peer to the flow
```
Priya (People Ops): Manager checklist (short):
- Set weekly 1:1 cadence (first 3 months)
- Assign mentor and schedule 30-min weekly sync for first 6 weeks
- Define 3 measurable outcomes with milestones (30/60/90)
- Confirm access: repo, Console, Dedicated, KMS, SSO, Slack, Google Drive
- Confirm hardware, badge, remote access working day 0
- Add to oncall rotation plan when ready, and schedule first shadowed shift
Alex M: This is great. Priya — can you drop the calendar template + one-pager who-to-ask into the Hire folder (PDF + Google Doc)?
Priya (People Ops): Done — uploaded to Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/onboard/senior-platform-templates (PDF + Google Doc).
OnboardBot: Calendar event "Intro - Dedicated & Console" created for Tue 10:00 with Jamal and Marta.
Sam R: Small add — schedule a 30-min "observability expectations" with Eng SRE in week 1 (helps set runbook expectations).
Alex M: Adding that now. Thanks everyone :rocket:
